P00.name: Raw_NoInstruction_OriginalReference
P00.description: Raw prompt directly fed to tokenizer, no chat template, no format instruction. Identical to original M0-FC40 Kaggle execution.

P01.name: Raw_WithInstruction
P01.description: Raw prompt appended with short-answer instruction, no chat template.
P01.template_fn: lambda p: p.strip() + '\nAnswer directly with only the option letter (a, b, c, d) or Yes/No.'

P10.name: ChatML_NoInstruction
P10.description: Standard Qwen ChatML formatting with generic system prompt, but without extra answer-format instruction.

P11.name: ChatML_PartnerParityCanonical
P11.description: Exact partner canonical evaluation prompt from ticktack_v2/eval/eval_mcqa_generative.py.
P11.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant. Please answer the question by selecting the correct option.
P11.user_template: {prompt}\nAnswer directly with only the option letter (a, b, c, d) or Yes/No.
